runtime.adminListFilters: admin media list supports optional mime/status filters with bound SQL and maxListRows limit
runtime.refListLimit: admin media reference list clamps request limit by maxRefListRows
runtime.publicRefCheckLimit: public access filter checks up to maxPublicRefCheckRows content refs per media
runtime.batchLimit: admin media batch rejects ids beyond maxBatchRows
runtime.batchResultUi: ability page renders media.batch as bounded summary and per-id result table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.requestLimit: admin media save/delete/batch rejects request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
runtime.attachmentFill: ability page media dialog can read host attachment metadata by xid and fill url/mime/ext/size/title
runtime.attachmentUploadMessage: host attachment upload page posts xadminAttachmentUploaded to opener and content.media ability page opens a prefilled media dialog
runtime.accessIntegration: public media list/detail filter resources whose content refs are restricted by content.access
